assertions.message: Verify Computed volatility matches with API Volatility
Verify Computed risk score matches with API Risk Score
Verify Computed profile value matches with API Profile Value

db_queries.monthlyPerformance_query: SELECT * FROM (SELECT TOP {{horizon}} a.MonthId, a.performance AS {{blend_1_id}}_Performance, b.performance AS {{blend_2_id}}_Performance FROM AM.dbo.MonthlyPerformance a INNER JOIN AM.dbo.MonthlyPerformance b ON a.MonthId = b.MonthId WHERE a.ItemId = '{{blend_1_id}}' AND b.ItemId = '{{blend_2_id}}' ORDER BY a.MonthId DESC) AS RecentMonths ORDER BY MonthId ASC
db_queries.riskBands_query: SELECT ProfileValue, AnnualStdDeviation FROM Platform.dbo.RiskProfile ORDER BY ProfileValue

test_scenario: Test EWMA blended risk calculation with 10 models (equal 10% weight each) and {{horizon}}-month time horizon. Validates annualized volatility, blended risk score, and profile value calculations.
